finalists.label: Lymphoma
finalists.why: It has a strong set of findings, including a destructive lesion centered on the anterior wall of the right maxillary sinus and heterogeneous enhancement after contrast administration.

finalists.label: Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis
finalists.why: It explains the rapid enlargement of the mass and the presence of a small fluid-attenuated focus.
